name: John Gray
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in Southampton County, Va., in 1783; pursued an academic course; member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 1804-1806 and 1821-1823; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Sixteenth Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of James Johnson (August 28, 1820-March 3, 1821); unsuccessful candidate in 1820 for reelection to the Seventeenth Congress; died May 18, 1823.
